summary: Refresh (no thesis change, 4 days to the event): MOLBREEVI (inhaled molgramostim) for autoimmune PAP has a Nov 22, 2026 PDUFA under Priority Review after a three-month extension, with no advisory committee. The stock is $4.75 (+6% today) against consensus of ~$8.86–10.56 (+87–122%). fda_decision is a core tier-2 leader (+8.1pp vs +4.1pp, n=11), a mild tailwind only. catalysts.name: MOLBREEVI PDUFA — aPAP (Priority Review)
catalysts.description: Resubmitted BLA; target action date Nov 22, 2026, extended from Aug 22 after a major amendment. It would be the first US-approved therapy for autoimmune PAP.

risks: Resubmission history: the original BLA hit a refuse-to-file/CMC snag, and the date was already extended once. Another CRL is possible.
Approval-likely pricing: the stock has not run, but a clean approval may still be a +20–40% event rather than a multiple re-rate.
Ultra-rare market (aPAP) means launch revenue ramps slowly.
Consensus target data is stale (Apr 2026), so upside is a best-effort estimate.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed funds 3.75–4.00% after the Sep 16 hike. CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~95% (Nov 17–18), with the remainder on 50bp. Waller has floated 50bp; Williams pushed back.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct CPI ran hot (core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2%). Sep core PCE 3.1% y/y. Oct PCE (Nov 25) and Nov CPI (Dec 10) are next.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Single-asset rare-disease biotech. The PDUFA dominates; rates matter only through small-cap biotech risk appetite.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — idiosyncratic FDA event in 4 days; macro (WAIT, 30/100) matters only for post-approval follow-through.
